sparse_interpretation: PUBLIC_DATA_ARTIFICIAL_SPARSE_SAMPLING; S1 A-year spacing shifted -20 calendar years; no Syr Darya observation used
basin_selection: Ascending numeric official gauge ID; first three with all days admissible for every month in union(primary_years,sparse_years); assess first50 IDs, never select by model scores

selection_criteria.daily_Q: finite >=0, not -999, ckhs=1, one record per native calendar date
selection_criteria.daily_T: finite, not -999; convert documented units only
selection_criteria.month_complete: every native calendar day has unique valid Q/P/T; 100 percent; reject duplicate dates

aggregation.Q: arithmetic mean of complete equal-duration daily means; m3/s

forcing_geometry: A: total upstream catchment, same official ID as discharge gauge
meteorology_is: ERA5-Land basin-aggregated reanalysis; NOT station-observed P/T
alpha_selection: Frozen S2 inner LOYO with one-SE; training-fold monthly climatology and sample std refit within every inner fold
exclusions: Only source definition/QC/completeness; no filtering by hydrograph agreement, residual or score
claims: Per-basin historical monthly reconstruction using target basin's other-year labels and same-month P/T; no strict zero-Q, no operational prediction, no Syr Darya performance, no independent multiple-basin inference
license_policy: Document page CC BY-SA4.0 and API CC BY4.0 discrepancy; comply with more restrictive CC BY-SA4.0 conditions, attribution and Info sources; local research only; no operational warnings
native_daily_window: 00:00 through 23:59 UTC for AUT/DEU/CHE, per ESSD section4.1; selected stations recorded in metadata
source_Q_processing: observational hydrographic-service Q; LamaH provider may have linearly filled <=6h gaps before daily aggregation; no additional filling performed here
qceq_qcol_policy: retain finite nonnegative ckhs=1 values; qceq/qcol are diagnostics, not proof of invalidity; record all flagged days; rare extremes/repeats are not automatically deleted
old_reference: Frozen old C0/E3n OOF imported, not refitted; new basins fit all4 once

model_definitions.C0+PT: fixed train monthly Q means + ridge(P_anom,T_anom); train-only monthly means/sample sd; objective sum_squared_residual + alpha sum(beta^2); no intercept changes

statistical_unit: year within basin; scenarios overlap and gauges share climate/networks; per-basin descriptive bootstrap999 and jackknife; no pooled independent-site inference
anomaly_definition: Qobs and each prediction minus SAME outer-training C0 month mean; zero anomaly benchmark; anomaly NSE equals skill_vs_C0; Pearson correlation N/A for constant prediction
